definitions: Shiny jewelry that displays wealth, such as a diamond ring or a stylish gold necklace or bracelet.

blocks.text: "Bling Bling" is a song by New Orleans rapper B.G., released by Cash Money and Universal Records on March 13, 1999 as both his debut single and the lead single for his fourth studio album, Chopper City in the Ghetto (1999). It features Cash Money labelmates Hot Boys and Big Tymers.

Bling Bling (เพชรประกาย) is a 2026 Thai boys' love romantic comedy-drama television series directed by Cheewin Thanamin Wongskulphat and produced by COPY A BANGKOK. The series stars Bank Sornram Aneklap (Bank) and Pimrapat Phadungwatanachok (Mobile), alongside Kantapon Chompupan (Guide), Narongdet Rungarun (Dech), Markpoom Phatsanan Thanachotsakulwong, and Cheriie Pichsinee Saejung.

Bling-bling, often shortened to just bling, is flashy jewelry and possessions displayed prominently to indicate wealth. The term arose in African American English before becoming general slang, ultimately growing into a cultural mainstay. Prominent examples of bling-bling include a large cross necklace or Jesus piece.

images.alt: Use of the phrase has grown in popularity, as demonstrated by this skywriting advertisement over a summer resort destination in Southampton, New York, in 2006.
